newsitem.title: USA: TransTexas oil column larger than expected.
newsitem.headline: TransTexas oil column larger than expected.

text.p: TransTexas Gas Corp said on Friday that its Dinsdale #1-3 well in North Dakota's Lodgepole formation logged an oil column of 148 feet, which is higher than initial logs of 78 feet.
The well was redrilled into the main body of the carbonate reef from a measured depth of 10,330 feet to 10,635 feet, TransTexas said.

The third well is expected to provide similar production characteristics as the first two wells in the reef. The Heart River #1 and the Dinsdale #2-4 flow-tested at rates of 6,836 and 5,544 barrels of oil per day respectively, the company said.

The wells are currently producing at a combined maximum allowable rate of 4,000 barrels per day and the third well will bring total daily production from the field to 6,000 barrels per day, the company said.
TransTexas said it owns a 71.2 percent working interest in the Dinsdale #1-3 and an average 62 percent working interest in the field.
